column1: # U7: managed users (td, yc, later service users), see ~/dotfiles/infrastructure/users/managed.tsv and `usr --help`

column9: fzf-menu list of the managed users. Enter opens a ghostty window as that user (machinectl shell, no password, a new tmux session that ends with the window), NORMAL a attaches to its tmux, s opens a plain shell, f files, l logs.
column10: u t;Terminal as a managed user

column9: Per user: uid, flags, open sessions, processes, dotfiles link, the owner's ACL on its home.

column3: Publish dotfiles to the managed users
column9: Publishes the committed ~/dotfiles (no secrets) to /srv/dotfiles; the git hooks do it after every commit. Relinks the profiles when they changed.

column3: Install nvim plugins and Mason for the managed users
column9: Installs the pinned plugins and the Mason tools into /srv/nvim-shared, which every managed user reads (read-only). Skips when it is up to date; --force reinstalls.
